strike.name: Strike
strike.desc: A blow at a foe in reach.

bow_shot.name: Bow Shot
bow_shot.desc: An arrow at any foe, even from the back row.

defend.name: Defend
defend.desc: Brace: take less harm until your next turn.

split_arrow.name: Split the Arrow
split_arrow.desc: A mighty shot at any foe, often a critical hit.

pinning_shot.name: Pinning Shot
pinning_shot.desc: A light shot that pins a foe: slower, can't swap rows.

bridge_hold.name: Bridge Hold
bridge_hold.desc: Foes must attack John for 2 turns, and he braces.

staff_sweep.name: Staff Sweep
staff_sweep.desc: Hits every foe in reach and may knock them down.

flourish.name: Flourish
flourish.desc: Three quick cuts at one foe. Extra hard on knights.

tavern_brawl.name: Tavern Brawl
tavern_brawl.desc: A punch at a foe in reach. Often stuns for a turn.

rally.name: Rally
rally.desc: The whole band hits harder for 2 turns.

shield_wall.name: Shield Wall
shield_wall.desc: Brace: take less harm until the next turn.

crossbow_bolt.name: Crossbow Bolt
crossbow_bolt.desc: A heavy bolt at any foe. May pin them.

charge.name: Lance Charge
charge.desc: A long lance charge at any foe.

throw_net.name: Throw Net
throw_net.desc: Nets a foe so they lose turns until cut free.

gisborne_duel.name: Gisborne's Blade
gisborne_duel.desc: A fierce sword blow, often a critical hit.

rousing_ballad.name: Rousing Ballad
rousing_ballad.desc: Heals the whole band and they hit harder for 2 turns.

lullaby.name: Lullaby
lullaby.desc: A soft song at any foe. Usually puts them to sleep.
